basic_info.description: Elegant full-floor condo located in iconic Nob Hill. Featuring exquisite architectural details, original hardwood floors, 9.5 feet ceiling height, and abundant natural light. The inviting living room welcomes you with its barrel-glass bay windows, brick fireplace, and beautifully detailed ceiling trim. Adjacent to the living room is the formal dining room with striking box beam ceilings & custom built-in cabinetry; original pocket doors separate the rooms. The updated kitchen features a central island, brand-new countertops, ample cabinet space, and stainless-steel appliances- including a new refrigerator and stovetop. A large butler's pantry connects the kitchen to the dining room. Laundry room with a washer & dryer is located just off the kitchen. The spacious layout includes three generous bedrooms, one off the hallway and two at the rear of the home overlooking the serene, shared garden. The primary bedroom allows enough space to add another bathroom making it an en-suite. Additional highlights include: ample in-unit storage, 1-car parking, private storage on the garage level, and low HOA dues. The unit has a private entrance, new carpet on the stairs, and fresh interior paint throughout. Close to many shops/restaurants & public transportation
